workflow_hypothesis: Stale per-code instrumentation metadata triggers a pre-refresh version assertion
pattern: Pre-dispatch validation assumes current metadata on immutable executable artifacts
description: A runtime-wide monitoring update can leave immutable executable artifacts with stale or absent per-artifact metadata. If dispatch validates version consistency before selecting current per-artifact state or a runtime fallback, ordinary monitored execution can abort.
precondition: A runtime-wide monitoring configuration changes its version while previously created executable artifacts retain older metadata or lack a complete per-artifact monitoring structure.
critical_operation: An event dispatcher handles an event for such an artifact and selects the tools or handlers using artifact-level monitoring state.
interference: The artifact metadata is stale or unavailable, including artifacts that cannot be eagerly rewritten after the global monitoring change.
invalid_assumption: Dispatch assumes the artifact is current and safely validates it before refreshing metadata or choosing runtime-level fallback state.
failure: A version or consistency check fails, aborting the process during otherwise ordinary monitored execution.
search_strategy: Trace runtime-wide monitoring-version changes and verify synchronization of already-created executable artifacts.
Inspect dispatch paths for version or consistency assertions that run before metadata refresh or fallback selection.
Check immutable or shared artifacts for lazy, stale, or absent per-artifact monitoring state after global configuration changes.
Verify that dispatch separates events requiring per-artifact data from events that can use runtime-level monitoring state.
Exercise configuration changes followed by events in previously created static or shared artifacts.

evidence.supports: The report shows monitored execution aborting when an event reached a static code object whose instrumentation version differed from the runtime version; the fix moved validation into tool selection and added runtime fallback when per-code data was absent.

scope_note: This is a cautiously scoped singleton pattern. It covers pre-dispatch validation failures involving versioned monitoring metadata on static or lazily refreshed executable artifacts; the report does not establish a broader rule for unrelated stale-state assertions.
